texts.facts: The case of the petitioner is that he was granted license to open a buffalo meat shop by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India vide license dated 18.07.2025, which is valid till 17.07.2026. After obtaining the license and after completing all the required formalities, it is the case of the petitioner that she want to inaugurate her meat shop but prevented by respondent nos. 2 & 3 i.e. Superintendent of Police, Maharajganj and Station House Officer, Police Station Kothibhar, District Maharajganj, respectively. He has also pointed out that two representations are being made, which are annexures 2 & 3. These representations are still not being decided.
